heading: Saturday Night
text: Mostly clear to start, then increasing high clouds after midnight. Lows from the mid 30s to lower 40s, except mid 20s to lower 30s northeast and in the Adirondacks. Winds light and variable from the Green Mountains eastward, becoming south near 10 mph in areas west of the Greens.

heading: Sunday
text: Some early fog east of the Greens, then sun filtering through increasing high clouds. Chance of afternoon showers near the Massachusetts border, becoming likely late, with a rising chance up to around Route 4. Highs from the upper 50s to mid 60s, south to north, some upper 60s possible in the St. Lawrence Valley. Winds becoming south 5 to 15 mph, and gusting to 30 mph from the Green Mountains westward.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Mostly cloudy, with showers likely south of the Adirondacks and Route 4, chance farther north. Lows in the upper 40s to lower 50s, with some lower 40s northeast, and some mid 50s in the broad valleys west. South to southeast winds 5 to 10 mph.
